title: OnboardingStageDefinition
description: A stage in a playbook's lifecycle. The playbook declares the order; `entityStatus` is the status the handoff workflow is expected to set when the asset arrives here, so the playbook and the workflow agree on one vocabulary.

displayName.description: Label shown on the lifecycle rail, e.g. `In Review`.

entityStatus.description: Status the asset carries while in this stage. Set by the handoff workflow, never by onboarding.

entryStage.description: The stage an asset is created into. Exactly one stage per playbook is the entry stage.

terminal.description: No further gates after this stage.
